verdict.rationale: Phoenix's SDK supports programmatic dataset creation (docs-25/65/gh-1), running evaluations on datasets with code-based or LLM-as-judge evaluators (docs-17/18/50/61), and capturing/reading back detailed results including scores, reasoning, and timing (docs-42/51). The remote MCP server further lets an agent directly 'query, and operate on ... datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations' (docs-58/69), covering the full create-eval-read loop programmatically or via agent tool calls. Missing for 10: end-to-end code example or independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can chain create-dataset→trigger-eval→read-results without manual UI steps.
